The problem

Your product is hard to use

  • Users drop off at the same point in your funnel
  • Your interface looks different on every screen
  • Onboarding takes too many steps and users abandon
  • Design and development are out of sync — devs build what's not designed
  • You have no design system, so every new feature starts from scratch

How we work

Steps & timeline

01

Discover

Week 1

We interview users, audit your current product, and map the journey.

02

Define

Week 1–2

We define the information architecture, user flows, and key screens.

03

Design

Week 2–4

We design high-fidelity interfaces and build a clickable prototype in Figma.

04

Deliver

Week 5

We hand off a complete design system, specs, and assets to your dev team.
